Theme

Latin word

clārus

clārus, clāra, clārum

bright, clear; bright, clear, shining; famous, renowned; loud, clear (of a voice or sound)

In this lexicon

  • bright

    also used · classical · Lucr. 2.830: color clārissimus (Lewis & Short)

  • bright

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Am. 1.3.49: lūce clārā et candidā (Lewis & Short); Lucr. 3.1; Hor. S. 2.7.48 (Lewis & Short)

  • famous

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 46.6: ad clārās Asiae volēmus urbēs; Quint. 1.1.36: dicta clārōrum virōrum

  • loud

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Clu. 134: clārā vōce (Lewis & Short); Traupman 342
